name: dsh-dag-plugin
description: DSH Multi-Agent DAG plugin monorepo: @evo-router/dag-core (framework-free orchestration core) + @evo-router/dsh-dag (DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @evo-router/dag-core && npm run build -w @evo-router/dsh-dag
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @evo-router/dag-core && npm run typecheck -w @evo-router/dsh-dag
scripts.test: npm run test -w @evo-router/dag-core && npm run test -w @evo-router/dsh-dag
